_comment: Octail's own egg (plan §6.4), written from the server's own files (AskaServer.bat, the shipped "server properties.txt") and Sand Sailor Studio's setup guide; there is no pelican-eggs ASKA egg. The server runs on octail-server-properties.txt (-propertiesPath), made once from the shipped file because updates overwrite that one, with the Startup tab's name, session name, seed, password, ports, token, region, keep-alive, autosave style and mode set in it (file parser, "key = value") before every start; the install makes sure each of those keys has a line. Unity's log goes to the console (-logFile -), the start is detected from the bound game port (x_octail.features.ready) or a session line (a guess until a real run shows the server's own), the query port gets its own automatic port (port_vars) with the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, Ctrl+C is handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1) and waited for, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: ASKA
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Lead a Viking clan: build a village, give your villagers tasks and survive the seasons with up to four players. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: export SteamAppId=1898300; wine ./AskaServer.exe -nographics -batchmode -propertiesPath octail-server-properties.txt -logFile - & ASKA_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${ASKA_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${ASKA_PID}" INT TERM; wait ${ASKA_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/AskaServer.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the ASKA dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: updates overwrite the shipped "server properties.txt" (AskaServer.bat says to keep a copy elsewhere), so
## the server runs on its own copy, octail-server-properties.txt (-propertiesPath), made once from the shipped file
## (or a short one when the game ships none); an existing copy is kept. Every line Octail sets before each start
## ("key = value", the file parser matches "key =") must be there, so a missing key gets a line of its own.
CFG=/mnt/server/octail-server-properties.txt
if [[ ! -f "$CFG" ]]; then
    if [[ -f "/mnt/server/server properties.txt" ]]; then
        cp "/mnt/server/server properties.txt" "$CFG"
    else
        printf '%s\n' "// ASKA dedicated server settings, written by the Octail install." > "$CFG"
    fi
fi
sed -i 's/\r$//' "$CFG"
for key in "save id" "display name" "server name" "seed" "password" "steam game port" "steam query port" \
    "authentication token" "region" "keep server world alive" "autosave style" "mode"; do
    grep -q "^${key} =" "$CFG" || echo "${key} = " >> "$CFG"
done

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The host name in the session list.

variables.name: Session Name
variables.description: The name of a new save (an existing save keeps its own).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password (no spaces).

variables.name: Seed
variables.description: Optional: the seed of a new save. Empty = random.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: The region the session opens in; default pings the best one.
rules: in:default,asia,japan,europe,south america,south korea,usa east,usa west,australia,canada east,hong kong,india,turkey,united arab emirates,usa south central

variables.name: Keep World Alive
variables.description: true: the world keeps running with nobody online. false: it loads when the first player joins and unloads when the last one leaves.

variables.name: Autosave
variables.description: When the server saves: every morning (in game), every 5, 10, 15 or 20 minutes, or disabled.
rules: in:every morning,every 5 minutes,every 10 minutes,every 15 minutes,every 20 minutes,disabled

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: normal, or custom to use the terrain, season and population settings in octail-server-properties.txt (for a new save).

variables.name: Authentication Token
variables.description: Optional: a Steam game server login token for the ASKA game (app 1898300, steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers), so the server can sign in to Steam without a Steam client.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).
